title: Strong and Courageous
speaker: Andrew Cartledge
blurb:
What do you do when the thing standing between you and everything you're hoping for feels completely impossible to overcome? And what if the real problem isn't the size of the obstacle, but something much closer to home?

In this sermon, Andrew Cartledge digs into one of the most honest and human moments in the entire Bible, where a group of ordinary people stood right on the edge of everything they had been waiting for and still couldn't take the step. What he uncovers about fear, courage, and what it actually takes to move forward is something most people have never heard framed quite this way. You'll also discover why ten people who were part of one of history's most pivotal moments have been almost completely forgotten, and what that might mean for your own life right now.

Watch this and see what it stirs up in you.
